subject: Trial plan & acceptance criteria — proposed timeline and exec readout
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@acmehealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Trial plan & acceptance criteria — next steps

Hi Sana + Rajiv,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. I pulled together a concise plan so we can lock the trial scope and timelines. Goal here is to make the POC low friction and scoped to the evaluation criteria that matter to your execs.

High-level proposal (4-week pilot):
- Week 0 (kickoff): dataset handoff + network access + security checklist (2 business days)
- Week 1–3 (trial): integration + sample traffic + evaluation runs
- Week 4 (readout): consolidated metrics, demo, and go/no-go decision

Success criteria (suggested):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for 1k-token inference under typical traffic (synthetic and sample workload)
- Quality: top-1 automated match >= 86% on your annotated 500-sample test set (we'll review failure cases)
- Cost signal: projected per-1k-token execution cost within your target band (we'll show cost breakdown at readout)
- Reliability: <= 2% error rate on end-to-end calls across 48h smoke tests

Owners:
- Acme: Sana (Product) — dataset & acceptance sign-off; Rajiv (Infra) — network & security
- Redwood: Jonas (AE) — overall coordination; Marissa (CS) — trial orchestration/readout; Grace (Solutions) — integration and evaluation scripts

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm the three success criteria above or suggest edits by EOD Friday
2) Share a representative sample dataset (anonymized) + any special prompt templates
3) Provide a technical contact for VPC/egress setup (Rajiv?)

Attachments: trial-success-metrics.xlsx (metric breakdown), mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (timeline & owners), sample-prompts.json (format examples).

Proposed exec readout window: Tues 2026-10-13 or Wed 2026-10-14, 30–45 minutes (we'll present results + recommendation). If those dates don't work, tell us best alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Jonas

From: Sana Patel <sana@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Trial plan & acceptance criteria — next steps

Jonas — thanks for the clear summary. This aligns well with what we'll need for the execs. Two quick adjustments from our side: 

1) Quality acceptance: can we define the evaluation as "top-1 precision on the 500-sample set" rather than "automated match"? That maps to our internal scoring.
2) Timeline: given some regulatory sign-off for data transfer, can we shift kickoffs by 3 business days (so Week 0 starts 2026-10-12)? The rest of the cadence looks fine.

Exec availability: we prefer Wed 2026-10-14 10:00–10:45am PT for the readout (Sana + CTO + Head of Clinical Ops). If Redwood can do that slot, we'll book the calendar invite and loop in our procurement lead.

I'll upload the anonymized sample set to the Drive folder you linked by EOD today and confirm the network contact (Rajiv will own).

On another note, our procurement team will want a draft SOW and simple T&Cs before the readout — nothing formal, just a starting doc so they can validate internal budget cadence.

Thanks,
Sana

- Me (Marissa): I'll own the readout agenda and collate slides for the exec demo. Draft agenda below — please provide slide owners by Monday:
  - 5m introductions and objective alignment (Jonas)
  - 10m integration summary + reliability results (Grace)
  - 10m quality metrics + failure analysis (Grace + Acme sample)
  - 10m cost/operational considerations + next contract steps (Marissa)
  - 5m Q&A and go/no-go vote (Sana + Acme execs)

- Procurement/SOW: Jonas — please prep a one-page SOW and MSA summary we can share with Acme's procurement ahead of the readout. We should have a DocuSign-ready doc (simple committed pilot price + 30-day post-pilot opt-in) so procurement has something concrete.

I'll tentatively block Wed 2026-10-14 10:00–10:45am PT on our calendars; Jonas please confirm once Acme sends the calendar invite.
